title: 14 一波带走，的双鬼
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

团队赛，虚空站位中规中矩。

弹药专家和枪炮师侧翼掩护，双鬼居中控阵，牧师站在最后，第六人是刺客鬼灯萤火。

如果说跟吴羽策打是恶心，那团队赛面对虚空的双鬼拍阵就是加倍的恶心，1+1大于2那种。

越云这边没什么高明的阵法，一如既往周珈蓝站在最前方，队友簇拥在她左右。

倒计时结束，大屏幕上，阿茜娜依然秉持一贯的策略，当先冲锋。

但这把抽选到的地图是雨林迷障，地形复杂，障碍物多，雨声淅淅沥沥干扰听脚步，还有迷雾挡视线。

对虚空来说，这种地图是梦寐以求，但是对越云来说，简直就是一场噩梦。

绚丽光影爆发，远程技能和鬼阵接连落下，战场被切割开，阿茜娜和队友的角色顺势分散。

解说惋惜道，“越云这把运气不太好，可以看出来队内战术能力存在很大的缺陷，上赛季在孙翔手上也有同样的问题，越云前后两位狂剑队长都不擅长战术布局啊。”

其实他说的算是客气了，从目前表现上来看，越云何止欠缺战术能力，简直根本就不存在战术这么个东西。

“切掉阿茜娜，越云就将陷入群龙无首的混乱，切割战场，逐个击破，这是虚空双鬼的拿手好戏，他们开始行动了……他们的第一个目标是狂剑士阿茜娜！”

淅淅沥沥的雨声和迷雾中，白发少女狂剑在雨林深处行走。

屏幕光影打在周珈蓝脸上，她的脸色雪白，漂亮而漠然不带活人气儿，简直像ai生成的完美无缺的电子娃娃。

鬼阵落在地上时，周珈蓝意识到自己赌赢了。

来抓自己，意味着虚空两位绝对核心没有机会去追自己的队友们。

他们想的是斩首战术，刚好，周珈蓝也这么想。

迷雾之后，逢山鬼泣高举双手吟唱，暗紫色的阵纹悄无声息蔓延成型。

红莲天舞的刀光切开迷雾，吴羽策的鬼刻真的像个鬼魂一样从上方斜切下来，重剑上撩，阿茜娜举剑格挡，下一刻又一个鬼阵在脚下绽放，封住了她还击的可能性。

真的很恶心，被鬼刻缠上之后的打法。

阿茜娜的血量稳定下滑，鬼刻并不被迷惑，始终保持不远不近的距离，拉扯缠斗，并不愿轻易与阿茜娜贴脸。

远处传来枪炮声，队友也在交手。

周珈蓝知道吴羽策在等，她也在等。

她不知道逢山鬼泣的大招在什么时候落下——

就是现在！

紫色阵纹冲破迷雾大放光彩，鬼神盛宴开启，炎阵、温阵、冰阵、寂静之阵同时被引爆，鬼刻飞快后退也开始吟唱，蓄力的阵纹在地面上再次亮起。

阿茜娜的血条已经滑到了百分之五十以下。

嗜血奋战，冲撞刺击，崩山击。

屏幕背后吴羽策瞪大眼，来了又来了，就是这幽灵一样飘忽的走位，她冲过李轩的鬼阵，直冲到了逢山鬼泣脸上。

但现在场上的是双鬼，鬼刻捏在手里的鬼阵立刻释放。

不、不对，这一次阿茜娜扭动的弧度不对，失误了？这种精细操作的确有可能——但是不是，这不是失误。

吴羽策眼睁睁看着雾气中拉出模糊的轮廓，这原本与双鬼天作之合的迷雾竟然成了她的遮掩。

雾气中少女狂剑幽灵一样飘忽的闪过逢山鬼泣，直冲鬼刻而来，所有鬼阵在此刻落空，鬼刻进入技能空白期。

时间刚好到了，雨林深处的迷雾散开，雪白宛如有实体的雾气一丝丝一缕缕散开，露出其后森严狰狞的少女狂剑。

这一次是正面对敌，所以吴羽策看见少女狂剑的脸模，除了漂亮之外没有别的形容，像文艺复兴时期推崇的希腊女神雕塑，永恒青春的女神高高站在圣殿之上，脸上没有表情只是一片漠然。

可是很美，美得让他心脏停跳。

……原来美神行走于地面上，是以这样的神态和这样的容貌。

先前的缠斗阿茜娜一直在掉血，但鬼刻付出的代价也不小，这种级别的对手不是轻易能缠住的，他的血条不比阿茜娜好到哪里去。

所以怎么没想到呢，比起状态更好的逢山鬼泣，她当然会选择送走更虚弱的鬼刻，只是调整一下冲锋方向而已，这已经不是她第一次这么干了，轻车熟路。

下一秒钟，鬼刻，血量清零，率先出局。

队友意识到不妙立刻赶来援助，但是已经晚了，空了大招之后的逢山鬼泣在阿茜娜面前跟一个虚弱的小男孩没有区别。

虚空枪炮师率先赶来，但逢山鬼泣已经倒在地上，下一秒钟阿茜娜顶着血皮仓皇逃窜，越云牧师的技能落在她身上，瞬间拉起摇摇欲坠的血线。

Page (1/3)

In the team competition, Void’s positioning is quite satisfactory.

The ammunition expert and the gunnery division cover the flanks, the two ghosts control the formation, the priest stands at the end, and the sixth person is the assassin Gui Deng Yinghuo.

If fighting Wu Yuce is disgusting, then facing the Void's double ghost formation in a team match is doubly disgusting, 1+1 is greater than 2.

Yue Yun didn't have any clever formations. As always, Zhou Jialan stood at the front, with her teammates surrounding her.

The countdown ended, and on the big screen, Athena still adhered to her usual strategy and charged first.

But the map I picked was a rainforest, with complex terrain and many obstacles. The sound of raindrops disturbed my footsteps, and the fog blocked my sight.

For Void, this kind of map is a dream, but for Yue Yun, it is simply a nightmare.

Brilliant light and shadow erupted, long-range skills and ghost arrays fell one after another, the battlefield was cut open, and the characters of Asina and her teammates dispersed.

The commentator lamented, "Yueyun is not very lucky. It can be seen that there are big flaws in the team's tactical ability. Sun Xiang had the same problem last season. The two mad sword captains before and after Yueyun are not good at tactical layout."

In fact, he was being polite. Judging from his current performance, Yue Yun not only lacks tactical ability, but there is no such thing as tactics at all.

"Cut off Athena, and Yueyun will fall into leaderless chaos. Cutting up the battlefield and defeating them one by one. This is the specialty of the two ghosts of the void. They started to take action... Their first target is the mad swordsman Athena!"

Amidst the patter of rain and mist, the white-haired girl Kuang Jian walked deep in the rain forest.

The light and shadow of the screen hit Zhou Jialan's face. Her face was white, beautiful and indifferent, like a perfect electronic doll generated by AI.

When the ghost array fell to the ground, Zhou Jialan realized that he had won the bet.

Coming to catch themselves means that the two absolute cores of Void have no chance to chase their teammates.

They were thinking of a beheading tactic, and it just so happened that Zhou Jialan thought the same.

After the fog, Ghost Cry raised his hands in the air and chanted, and the dark purple formation spread silently and took shape.

The sword light of Honglian Tianwu cut through the fog, and Wu Yuce's ghost carving was really like a ghost. It cut diagonally from above. The heavy sword was lifted up. Athena raised her sword to block. The next moment, another ghost formation bloomed under her feet, sealing the possibility of her fighting back.

It's really disgusting, the way you fight after being entangled by Gui Ke.

Asina's blood volume steadily declined, Gui Ke was not confused, and always kept a close distance, fighting, and unwilling to get close to Asina easily.

The sound of gunfire was heard in the distance, and teammates were also fighting.

Zhou Jialan knew Wu Yuce was waiting, and she was waiting too.

She didn’t know when Fengshan Devil May Cry’s ultimate move came down——

That's it now!

The purple array broke through the fog and shined brightly. The feast of ghosts and gods began. The flame array, the warmth array, the ice array, and the silence array were detonated at the same time. The ghosts retreated quickly and began to sing, and the charged arrays lit up again on the ground.

Athena's health bar has slipped below fifty percent.

Fighting with bloodthirsty, charging and stabbing, attacking with mountain collapse.

Wu Yuce's eyes widened behind the screen, and it came again and again, moving erratically like a ghost. She rushed through Li Xuan's ghost formation and rushed straight to Fengshan Guiwei's face.

But now there are two ghosts on the field, and the ghost formation in Gui Ke's hand is released immediately.

No, no, the arc of Asiana's twist this time was wrong. Was it a mistake?This kind of delicate operation is indeed possible - but no, this is not a mistake.

Wu Yuce watched helplessly as a blurry outline emerged from the mist. The mist that was originally a perfect match for the two ghosts turned out to be her cover.

In the mist, the girl's mad sword flashed across the mountain like a ghost, heading straight towards Gui Ke. All the ghost formations failed at this moment, and Gui Ke entered a skill blank period.

The time had just arrived, and the mist in the depths of the rainforest dispersed. The snow-white mist dispersed like a solid piece of mist, revealing the stern and ferocious girl's mad sword behind it.

This time he was facing the enemy head-on, so when Wu Yuce saw the face of the young girl Kuang Jian, there was no other way to describe it other than beautiful. It looked like the Greek goddess sculpture admired during the Renaissance. The goddess of eternal youth stood high above the temple, with no expression on her face but a look of indifference.

But it was beautiful, so beautiful that it made his heart stop.

...It turns out that the God of Beauty walks on the ground with such an attitude and appearance.

Athena had been losing blood in the previous fight, but Gui Ke had paid a high price. It was not easy to trap an opponent of this level, and his health bar was no better than Athena's.

So why didn't she expect that compared to Fengshan Devil May Cry, who was in better condition, she would of course choose to send away the weaker Guike, just adjusting the direction of the charge. This was not the first time she had done this, and she was familiar with the road.

The next second, the ghost moment, the blood volume is cleared, and he is the first to be eliminated.

Teammates realized something was wrong and rushed to help immediately, but it was already too late. After using his ultimate move, Ghost Crying in the Mountains was no different from a weak little boy in front of Assina.

The Void Gunner came first, but Fengshan Devil May Cry had already fallen to the ground. The next second, Athena fled in a hurry with her bloody skin. Pastor Yueyun's skill fell on her, instantly pulling up the shaky blood line.
